draft.emotion: warm and appreciative, acknowledging someone's thoughtful act
notes: A な-adjective (親切な) and noun. The person receiving kindness is marked with に (e.g., 私に親切にしてくれた — was kind to me).
Unlike 優しい (yasashii), which describes a gentle or sweet nature, 親切 focuses on active helpfulness toward others.
